title: Amend my claim for holiday pay accrued
description: Amend an existing redundancy claim for accrued holiday pay by correcting the leave year start date, days entitled, days taken and days carried over. Verify identity with claim reference and National Insurance number. Does not cover holiday taken but not paid.

title: Amend my claim for holiday taken but not paid
description: Amend an existing redundancy claim for holidays taken but not paid, changing the holiday year start date, leave entitlement in days, or dates of unpaid holiday. Verify identity with your claim reference and National Insurance number first.

title: Further Education Leadership Mentoring Programme Diversity Form
description: Provide diversity monitoring information for the Further Education Leadership Mentoring Programme, including gender, ethnicity, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, region, and social background such as school type, free school meals and parents' university attendance.

title: Request your approved driving instructor (ADI) driving test data report
description: Request a report of your driving test data as an approved driving instructor (ADI). Provide your name, ADI personal reference number, date of birth, postcode and email address, and DVSA will email the report to you. It does not book ADI tests.

title: Apply to be a volunteer coastguard rescue officer
description: Apply to volunteer as a Coastguard Rescue Officer with the Maritime and Coastguard Agency at a recruiting station. Choose an area and station, give personal details, motivation, previous service experience and availability, including working hours and times.

title: Notify us of an accident or incident: form N1
description: Notify the Rail Accident Investigation Branch (RAIB) of a railway accident or incident. Collects organisation and contact details, location, date, time, type and description of the event, details of up to two trains involved, casualty numbers and other relevant information.

title: Application for authorisation to use Northern Ireland Plant Health Labels (NIPHL)
description: Apply for new authorisation to use Northern Ireland Plant Health Labels when moving goods from Great Britain. Collects business and contact details, whether you trade plants for planting, used agricultural or forestry machinery, or seed potatoes, and related declarations. Not for annual renewals.

title: Amend my claim for unpaid wages
description: Amend an existing redundancy claim for unpaid wages made to the Insolvency Service. Confirm your identity with your claim reference and National Insurance number, then give corrected details of wages owed, unpaid dates, net or gross amounts and any attachment of earnings.

title: Raise a concern with Public Procurement Review Service
description: Raise a concern about a contracting authority's procurement or contract, including unpaid invoices, with the Public Procurement Review Service. Collects your contact and organisation details, the procurement and its value, a description of the complaint, and whether you want to stay anonymous.

title: Register to become a plant health professional operator
description: Register a business as a plant health professional operator with the Animal and Plant Health Agency. Collects trading name, contact details, main production site grid reference, premises type, business activity, commodities handled, sales distribution and where planting material is sourced.

title: Apply for a temporary certificate of competence to slaughter or kill animals
description: Apply for a temporary certificate of competence to slaughter or kill animals while working towards the WATOK qualification. Collects your personal details, FDQ registration number, slaughterhouse approval number, activity and species codes, and any refusals, suspensions or convictions.

title: Amend my personal details
description: Amend personal details on an existing redundancy payment claim, such as name, National Insurance number, date of birth, email, home address or mobile number. Verify identity with the claim reference and current details; employment details are covered by a separate form.

title: Amend my employment details
description: Amend employment details on an existing redundancy claim: gross weekly pay, employment start and end dates, and the date notice was given. Verify your identity with your claim reference and National Insurance number. Personal details are changed using a separate form.

title: War Pension / Armed Forces Compensation Scheme Complaints Form
description: Make a complaint about the War Pension or Armed Forces Compensation Schemes, including escalating a previous complaint, for yourself or on someone's behalf. Not for Armed Forces Pension Scheme complaints, claim enquiries or status checks.

title: Replace a lost or damaged MOT centre authorisation certificate (VT9)
description: Request a replacement VT9 MOT centre authorisation certificate if it has been lost or damaged. Collects the applicant's role in the MOT business, authorised examiner name and number, and the MOT centre's name, address and number. DVSA emails the certificate.

title: Apply for Business Advisory Support from Growth Gateway
description: Apply for Growth Gateway business advisory support with exporting to the UK, finding funding or investors, and other help. Collects company details, sector, size, revenue, export experience and preparation, licences held, funding sought, and women-led or climate impact.

title: Expression of interest to become authorised to issue Plant Passports
description: Register interest in becoming authorised to issue UK Plant Passports. Collects the business trading name, head office address, the person responsible for plant passporting, contact phone and email, and an optional APHA customer reference number.

title: Request an exemption from using the GOV.UK website
description: Request an exemption from having to publish on GOV.UK, so a public sector organisation can run its own website on a separate domain. Collects organisation and sponsoring department details, approver, proposed domain name, and reasons and evidence that GOV.UK would not meet user needs.

title: Application for export services at concessionary rates
description: Apply for export services at concessionary rates, for businesses exporting plants and plant products. Collects the trading name, business address, VAT registration status and the total value of certified plant exports in the last financial year.

title: Apply to have an unduly lenient sentence reviewed
description: Ask the Attorney General's Office to review a Crown Court sentence in England or Wales that you think is unduly lenient, within 28 days of sentencing. Collects details of the offender, court, offences, your reasons and your connection to the victim.

title: Apply to replace a lost, stolen or damaged Driver CPC card
description: Request a replacement Driver CPC (driver qualification) card for lorry, bus or coach driving issued by DVSA in England, Scotland or Wales, if lost, stolen or damaged. Collects name, driving licence number, address and contact details; DVSA phones to take the fee.

title: Apply to replace a lost or stolen motorcycle CBT certificate
description: Apply to DVSA for a replacement motorcycle CBT certificate that was lost or stolen, after the training school has not replaced it. Collects course completion date, training school name and site postcode, details of your request to the school, and driving licence number.

title: HR1 - Advanced Notification of Redundancies
description: Notify the Insolvency Service of proposed redundancies of 20 or more employees at one establishment. Collects company details, a contact person, site addresses, redundancy numbers, dismissal dates, reasons, selection method and union or employee representative consultation.

title: Apply for or replace an armed forces veterans badge
description: Apply for a first or replacement armed forces veterans badge, either for yourself or for a deceased serviceperson if you receive a War Widow or Widower's Pension or SGIP. Collects service details, such as force and service number, and a UK or overseas postal address.

title: Disqualified Director Sanctions - Individual licence application request
description: Request the individual licence application form for someone disqualified as a director under the UK Sanctions Regime, to act as a director or promote, form or manage a named company. Collects sanctions list ID, personal details, company details and contact details, including for representatives.

title: Close your MOT centre
description: Notify DVSA that an MOT centre is closing. Authorised examiner principals or designated managers give their role, trading name, authorised examiner name and number, the MOT centre number or numbers, and the closure date.

title: Apply for a refund of MOT slot payments
description: Request a refund for unused MOT testing service slots bought by an authorised examiner. Collects the examiner number, trading name, number of slots to refund and current slot balance, with refunds returned to the card or sent by cheque.

title: Give feedback: Apply for a deceased person's military record
description: Give feedback on the Ministry of Defence service for requesting military records of service, including which service branch and application method you used, a satisfaction rating and suggestions for improvement. Not for complaints or reporting technical faults.

title: Get added to the dangerous goods safety adviser list on GOV.UK
description: Ask DVSA to add a qualified dangerous goods safety adviser to the public adviser list for the first time. Collects name, email, location, transport modes, dangerous goods classes, candidate number and certificate expiry date.

title: Tell the Home Office that you've separated or divorced
description: Notify the Home Office that a marriage or civil partnership has ended, as either the visa or status holder or the sponsoring partner. Collects both partners' details, relationship dates, any children in the UK, retained right of residence, and consent to contact the ex-partner.

title: Rooms Letting Information Form
description: Provide rent details for individual rooms let in a shared property, such as room type, rent, payment frequency, tenancy start date, shared facilities and included bills, for up to six rooms. Unlike the self-contained properties form, it covers rooms in shared accommodation.

title: Self contained properties Letting Information
description: Provide letting details for self-contained rental properties, including rent amount and frequency, property type, age, furnishing, rooms, tenancy start date and bills included. Landlords can add several properties, and are contacted in 12 months for an update.

title: Tell the Home Office that you're getting back together with your partner
description: Tell the Home Office that you and your partner have reconciled after a relationship breakdown, as either the visa or status holder or the sponsoring partner. Collects case references such as UAN, passport and visa application form number, plus both partners' details. Use the separate separation form to report a split.

title: Apply for a Workplace Charging Scheme for state-funded education institutions grant
description: Apply for a voucher towards electric vehicle chargepoints at state-funded schools, colleges and nurseries. Collects institution reference number, OZEV installer details, contacts, and chargepoint socket numbers across up to four sites, for one institution per application.

title: Apply to change a vessel's UK Fisheries Administration
description: Request a transfer of a fishing vessel's administration between England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland. Collects vessel details (PLN, RSS number), current and new administration and port, Producer Organisation or non-sector choice, and reasons for the transfer.

title: Apply to fish in Regional Fisheries Management Organisation (RFMO) waters
description: Apply for an external waters licence for a UK fishing vessel to fish in NEAFC, IOTC or NAFO regulated waters. Collects domestic licence and vessel identifiers, intended fisheries and start dates, quota access, owner and nominee details, and applicant role.

title: Sole Recovery Zone Days at Sea: Apply to transfer days at sea
description: Apply to transfer sole recovery zone effort days at sea from a donor fishing vessel to one or more recipient vessels. Collects vessel identifiers (PLN, RSS), engine power, kW day calculations, and contact details for the donor and recipient.

title: Fix mistakes on a vehicle's MOT record
description: Request DVSA to correct errors on a vehicle's MOT record, including wrong mileage backed by uploaded evidence, or details such as make, model, colour, fuel type, registration country or MOT centre. Collects vehicle, keeper or trade details and MOT test numbers.

title: Give feedback on Search for local land charges
description: Give feedback on the Search for local land charges service, including satisfaction ratings, suggested improvements and any help received, such as from HM Land Registry. Users say whether they are a member of the public or a professional, and can optionally give an email address for follow-up.

title: Report a regulatory issue
description: Report a regulatory issue affecting a UK profession's access to markets or service provision in another country or territory, including the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein. Describe the issue, its impact and the help wanted from the Department for Business and Trade.

title: Confirm you've received your medals
description: Confirm that you have received medals sent by the Ministry of Defence Medals Office, using the case number from your paper receipt. Collects your case number, full name and, optionally, the serviceperson's service number.

title: Report a dangerous goods road incident
description: Report a road incident involving dangerous goods to the Department for Transport under ADR 1.8.5. Collects consignor details, vehicle and location, conditions, goods and containment, causes, casualties, quantity lost, damage cost, and evacuation or route closure over 3 hours.

title: Register for MOT history API
description: Apply for access to the MOT history API, giving your contact details, organisation, role, intended use of the vehicle data and expected monthly users. Use this to request an API key, not to ask for support with an existing one.

title: Request MOT history API support
description: Request support for the MOT history API, such as fixing a faulty API key, unexpected or missing data, renewing an expired client secret, or updating contact details. Collects your name, email, issue type, a description and your API key if known.

title: Disqualified Director Sanctions - Company licence application request
description: Request a licence application form for a company subject to director disqualification sanctions under the UK Sanctions Regime, so it can act as a director or promote, form or manage a company. Collects the sanctioned company's details, the target company's details and contact details; not for individuals.

title: Test form 1
description: Test form for proposing a change to the Service Manual. Collects an email address and evidence of consensus across departments and professions, plus evidence the proposed practice has succeeded elsewhere and can be delivered.

title: Complain about a motorcycle CBT course problem you could not sort out with the training school
description: Complain to DVSA about the safety or standard of a motorcycle CBT course after failing to resolve it with the training school. Collects course date, school and site details, trainer names, the school's response and your contact details. Not for refund requests.

title: Register for a visitor mooring on the River Thames
description: Register your arrival at, or extend your stay at, an Environment Agency visitor mooring on the River Thames at Goring. Collects boat name, registration number, and the length of stay or extension. Payment is made separately.

title: Apply for payment easement as an SME
description: Apply to MHRA for payment easement as a small or medium-sized enterprise (SME). Collects organisation and MHRA customer details, the services concerned (such as clinical investigations or scientific advice), employee numbers, net assets, turnover and the latest audited accounts.

title: Application for a fishing licence for a registered fishing vessel administered by Marine Management Organisation (AFL2)
description: Apply to license a registered English or Crown Dependency fishing vessel, using existing licence entitlements. Collects vessel details from the certificate of registry, owners, nominees, gear types, entitlement numbers and optional Fish Hub registration. Not for AFL7 or AFL19 changes.

title: Expression of Interest - Science and Technology Venture Capital Fellowship
description: Register interest in the Science and Technology Venture Capital Fellowship before the formal application window opens. Collects contact details, UK residence, organisation and job title, years of investing experience, investing type and main investment sector.

title: Scheduled Smoke Test
description: Run scheduled smoke tests on GOV.UK Forms. This is a test form, not a real service, and it only contains placeholder text, number and full name questions where no specific answer is needed for the tests to pass.

title: Report an environmental issue by your employer
description: Report an environmental concern about a company you currently work for or recently worked for, as a whistleblower to the Environment Agency. Collects optional contact details, company type, a description of the issue, its location and how you found out.

title: Market Commentary
description: Give your views on the local private rental market, as a letting company, covering supply, demand, and likely rent changes for new and existing tenancies over the next 12 months. Includes optional remarks on exceptions and general market conditions.

title: Establishment or transfer of an entitlement and transfer of a licence that is administered by Marine Management Organisation (AFL7)
description: Establish a fishing vessel licence as an entitlement, or transfer a licence or licence entitlement to new holders, administered by the Marine Management Organisation. Collects licence and vessel details, permits, penalty points, current and new holder details, executor details and identity evidence. Does not split entitlements or apply for new licences.

title: Request your driving instructor services user ID
description: Request a user ID for DVSA driving instructor services, for approved driving instructors. Collects your name, driving licence number, postcode, date of birth, email address and, optionally, your ADI personal reference number. DVSA emails the user ID.

title: Lettings Information collection form - tenants
description: Provide rent and property details as a tenant renting a whole property, including tenancy start date, rent amount and frequency, property type, age, furnishing, rooms and bills included. Not for room-only lettings, which have a separate form.

title: Propose a change to the Service Manual
description: Propose a correction, update or addition to GOV.UK Service Manual content, giving the page URLs, the type of change, and evidence of consensus from other departments or professional communities. Not for changes to the Capability Framework.

title: Change the owner of a boat registered at Rye Harbour
description: Notify the harbour office of a change of owner for a boat registered at Rye Harbour. Collects the boat's name and registration number, the date ownership changed, the new owner's contact details, where the boat will be kept, and third-party insurance details.

title: Report a dangerous goods rail incident
description: Report a dangerous goods incident involving a rail wagon to the Department for Transport, as required under RID 1.8.5. Collects consignor details, wagon number, incident location and cause, goods and containment, casualties, quantity lost, damage cost, and evacuations or route closures.

title: Raise a referral for debarment with the Debarment Review Service
description: Refer a supplier to the Debarment Review Service for possible debarment under mandatory or discretionary exclusion grounds in the Procurement Act 2023, other than the two national security grounds. Collects supplier and connected person details, grounds, dates, self-cleaning actions, contract values and evidence.

title: Application to disaggregate/split a fishing vessel licence entitlement administered by Marine Management Organisation (AFL19)
description: Split a fishing vessel licence entitlement into two to five smaller entitlements, dividing its kW and tonnage and allocating permits and new holders. Not for transferring a whole entitlement (AFL7) or licensing a vessel (AFL2).

title: Pollack Compensation Scheme
description: Apply for a discretionary payment under the Pollack Compensation Scheme run by the Marine Management Organisation. Collects applicant contact details, fishing vessel and licence details (RSS and PLN numbers), and bank account details, with a declaration of eligibility.

title: Report a bus or coach accessibility problem for disabled passengers
description: Report a problem disabled passengers had with bus or coach accessibility features or driver help, such as ramps, wheelchair spaces or assistance dogs. Collects journey, stop and company details, and photos, with optional contact details to DVSA.

title: Report fraud or other misconduct to the Mining Remediation Authority
description: Report suspected fraud or other misconduct involving the Mining Remediation Authority. Describe what happened, who was involved, and where and when it took place, and say whether you have told another organisation. Name and contact details are optional.

title: Register for the Horizon Convictions Redress Scheme (HCRS)
description: Register for the Horizon Convictions Redress Scheme on behalf of yourself or someone whose conviction has been quashed, including as a legal representative, attorney or executor. Collects the applicant's details, conviction location, letter reference number and solicitor and contact preferences.

title: TEST - Apply to run a donkey sanctuary
description: Test form for applying to run a donkey sanctuary. Collects contact and organisation details, the licence length wanted (12, 6 or 3 months), whether the applicant has donkeys and how many, and a preferred start date. Rural Payments Agency contact.

title: Apply for an emergency travel document (first time applicant)
description: Apply for an emergency travel document from abroad if you have never held a UK passport issued since 1 January 2006 and have an urgent, unplanned reason to travel. Collects applicant and contact details, location and a summary of exceptional circumstances, for yourself or someone else.

title: SG test
description: Test form for internal use, not for real submissions. Collects whether the person was affected by the infected blood scandal, their passport issue date, the start of the tax year and their country of origin, with no payment taken.

title: Request someone from the CMA to speak at your event
description: Request a speaker from the Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) for your event. Collects event details, topic, speaker format, audience, attendance mode, press and recording arrangements, and other speakers, so the CMA can decide on the request.

title: Report a concern about a Poisons Act substance
description: Report a concern about a person or business in connection with a substance defined in the Poisons Act, such as explosives precursors. Give details of who and where they are and what worries you; your own contact details are optional. Sent to the Home Office Chemical Reporting Team.

title: Get help trading with Ukraine, Russia and Belarus.
description: Submit an enquiry to get help with trading or exporting involving Ukraine, Russia or Belarus. Collects contact details, business name and location, any relevant industry sectors, and a free-text description of the enquiry.

title: Request an uncertified copy of a trade mark
description: Request an uncertified copy of a UK trade mark, or of an opposition or cancellation record, using its number. Collects contact and postal details for delivery. Does not include a registration certificate, which must be requested by phone or email.

title: National Digital Exchange incubator wait list
description: Join the wait list for the National Digital Exchange incubator by giving your name, work email address and organisation. You can also say how you would use the service and how you heard about it.

title: Certificate of Merit Form
description: Nominate a member of a unit in Wales for a Certificate of Merit. Collects the nominee's service record, personal and contact details, a 250-word general recommendation, and the nominator's and commanding officer's details.

title: Contact OTSI
description: Send a query to the Office of Trade Sanctions Implementation (OTSI) about sanctions breaches and enforcement, sanctions licensing, exception notifications or general trade sanctions. Collects any existing reference number, your message, contact details and optional organisation and sector.

title: capybara test form 2024-05-29 16:15.33
description: Use as an automated test form (capybara test, dated 29 May 2024) for GOV.UK Forms. It asks whether the person wants to remain anonymous and for their name, with no file upload or payment, and is not for real submissions.

title: Propose a change to the Capability Framework
description: Propose a change to the Government Digital and Data Profession Capability Framework, such as a new role, skill or role level, or an edited skill or role description. Collects your details, the acceptance criteria check, the reasons for the change and two sponsors from other government organisations.

title: Report action taken under a volunteer bat roost visitor licence
description: Submit a report of action as a registered volunteer bat roost visitor licence holder (CL15 Level 1 or CL16 Level 2) to Natural England. Covers training provided, Bat Advice service duties, report submission, continued registration and any change of address or phone number.

title: Report a mosquito
description: Report a mosquito found in the UK to UKHSA, giving the collection date, location, habitat, whether you were bitten and up to three photos. A reference number is generated so specimens can be posted for identification, and contact details are collected.

title: Make a VDEC enquiry
description: Send an enquiry to UKHSA's Vaccine Development and Evaluation Centre (VDEC) team. Collects the nature of the enquiry and a work email address, with optional job title, organisation location and phone number.

title: Supplier Information Security Questionnaire
description: Complete the Ministry of Justice supplier security questionnaire using an invitation code. Provide details on the HMG/MoJ data you handle, where it is accessed and stored, third-party sharing, security certifications, risk management, and incident contacts.

title: Register your interest in the Pall Mall Process
description: Register interest in the Pall Mall Process by giving your name, organisation and email address, so the FCDO team can send you the link to the consultation. It collects contact details only and takes no payment.

title: .Hannah’s test form
description: Use this test form to try out GOV.UK Forms features, including payment, a long radio list, an eligibility exit on a Yes answer, address, phone, email, name and photo upload questions. It is not a real service.

title: Community drop-ins for Veterans
description: Submit details of a recurring community drop-in event for veterans so they can be published for veterans to find. Collects organisation name, event type, location, public contact email, how often and when it runs, and optional social media links.

title: Lettings Information Form - Tenants Room only
description: Provide rent details for a rented room in a shared property, for the Valuation Office Agency's rent officer functions. Collects room type, shared facilities, tenancy start date, rent amount and frequency, and any bills included. Use the separate tenants form for whole-property lettings.

title: U.K Public Sector FinOps event in Manchester 21st October 2024 signup
description: Sign up to attend the UK public sector FinOps event in Manchester on 21 October 2024. Collects your name, organisation or department, and email address, with an optional space to mention dietary or accessibility needs.

title: Enquiries about support and services available to veterans
description: Ask a question about support and services available to veterans, such as what counts as a veteran or which drop-ins are available in London. Collects your question and an optional email address, and Defence Relationship Management replies by email.

title: Get Certified Autumn 2024 signup
description: Sign up for the Get Certified programme running in autumn 2024 by giving your name, organisation or department, and email address. Applicants are then contacted with further details. No payment is taken.

title: Check how to export goods
description: Send an enquiry asking for help with how to export goods. Give a free-text description of what you need, plus your name and email address so you can be contacted about your question.

title: Notify the Debarment Review Service that a supplier has been excluded, replaced or removed from a public sector procurement
description: Notify the Debarment Review Service that a contracting authority has disregarded, excluded, replaced or removed a supplier under the Procurement Act 2023. Collects supplier and contact details, the exclusion grounds relied on, an explanation of the decision and optional supporting evidence.

title: Referral to a Minister of the Crown of intention to exclude a supplier or terminate a public contract with a supplier on grounds of national security
description: Refer an intention to exclude a supplier or terminate a public contract on discretionary national security grounds to a Minister of the Crown. Collects supplier, contract and contact details, plus the national security assessment and reasons for exclusion. Not for mandatory grounds or debarment list notifications.

title: Request an uncertified copy of a design
description: Request an uncertified copy of a registered design by giving its design number and your contact details. The copy is emailed if an electronic version exists, otherwise posted. It is not for trade marks or certified design copies.

title: Raise a referral for a national security debarment investigation
description: Refer a supplier to the Cabinet Office for possible debarment on national security exclusion grounds under the Procurement Act. Collects referrer and supplier details, any connected person, the national security threat assessment, whether circumstances are continuing, and the supplier's contracts and critical services.

title: Request to be included on the APHA register of authorised distance plant sellers
description: Request to add a business to the APHA register of authorised distance plant sellers. Collects trading name, head office address, contact details and APHA customer reference number, and confirms authorisation to issue Plant Passports.

title: capybara test form 2024-08-16 14:10.02
description: Use as an automated test form (capybara test, created 2024-08-16 14:10.02) for GOV.UK Forms. It asks whether the person wants to remain anonymous and for their name, and does not take payment. Not for real submissions.

title: Update your details on the dangerous goods safety adviser list
description: Update your details on the DVSA dangerous goods safety adviser list if you are already listed, including your region, town or postcode, transport modes and dangerous goods classes. Requires your candidate number and certificate expiry date. Not for first-time listing or certificate name changes.

title: Update a fishing vessel licence (AFL3)
description: Update a Marine Management Organisation fishing vessel licence to report changes to the vessel name, PLN, owner or nominee contact details, secondary contact, or main fishing gears. Requires the licence number and a certificate of registry for name, PLN or address changes.

title: Demo detailed guidance stuff
description: Demo or test form, not for real submissions. Collects a phone number answer to a question about continuing the form, and an uploaded annual report file, with no payment taken.

title: GBOT Feedback
description: Report a fault with the GBOT platform, or suggest an improvement or new idea, specifying whether it concerns Org Chart, Learning and Development or another section. Collects a description, contact email and an optional screenshot. Not for reporting data errors.

title: capybara test form 2024-10-07 09:32.14
description: Automated test form, not for real use, created by the GOV.UK Forms automation tests on 7 October 2024. Asks whether the person wants to remain anonymous and for their name, and does not take payment. It differs from the other capybara test forms only by its creation date.

title: Request MCA short course approval
description: Request Maritime and Coastguard Agency approval to deliver maritime short courses, for training providers not currently MCA approved. Collects company details, chosen courses, online or peripatetic delivery, country and location, plus optional supporting documents.

title: The Armed Forces Covenant
description: Start the process of signing the Armed Forces Covenant for an organisation. Give contact and organisation details, the senior signatory, and the pledges to support the Armed Forces community, and choose whether to appear on the public record of signatories.

title: Register your interest in user research
description: Register interest in taking part in user research on the Criminal Justice System delivery data dashboard, run by the Ministry of Justice. Collects your role in relation to the dashboard, such as public, legal professional or police, and your email address.

title: Environment Agency waterways: change of boat ownership or details and refund request form
description: Tell the Environment Agency, as the current registered owner, about a boat sale, change of address or contact details, boat leaving the waterways, move to trade exemption or Canal and River Trust gold licence purchase, and request a registration refund. Covers Anglian, Medway and non-tidal Thames boats.

title: Environment Agency waterways: boat registration renewal for existing Direct Debit customers
description: Renew a boat registration on Anglian Waterways, Medway Navigation or the non-tidal River Thames as an existing Direct Debit customer. Collects owner details, insurance, business and hire boat declarations, Boat Safety Scheme certificates and unpowered open boat details, with an optional Anglian Pass.

title: Apply for my merchant navy medal
description: Apply for a merchant navy campaign medal for your own service, choosing from listed medals such as Korea, Suez, Falklands or Gulf. Collects personal and service details, with discharge book pages and supporting documents as proof. Not for applications made on behalf of a veteran.

title: Apply to book vocational driving tests for your pupils
description: Apply for approval to book vocational driving tests on behalf of your pupils, by giving your name, driving school or business name, business address, phone number and email. It does not cover motorcycle tests or ADI qualifying tests.

title: Apply to hold a maypole dance
description: Apply for permission to hold a maypole dance by giving your name, address, email, phone numbers, date of birth, countries lived in, annual holiday days, and a reason for liking maypole dancing. You can upload a file and get an emailed outcome.

title: Apply to book motorcycle tests for your pupils
description: Apply for approval to book motorcycle tests on behalf of your pupils, by giving your name as on your driving licence and your riding school or business name, address, phone number and email. Covers motorcycle tests only, not vocational driving tests.

title: Apply for a new licence
description: Apply to the Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation (OFSI) for a financial sanctions licence, or amend an existing one, to permit dealings with a designated person's funds. Collects contact details, sanctions regime, licensing ground, transaction and bank payment route details, and supporting documents.

description: Automated test form, not for real use, created by a capybara test run on 11 November 2024 at 11:21. Asks whether the person wants to remain anonymous and for their name, then says an emailed outcome follows.

title: Report a cartel to the CMA
description: Report suspected cartels or other competition concerns to the CMA, including abuse of market power and bribery, fraud or corruption affecting competition. Give details of the issue, businesses involved and UK nation affected, and optionally upload up to four evidence files, with or without your contact details.

description: Use as an automated test form (capybara) created on 12 November 2024. It asks whether the person wants to remain anonymous and for their name, and is not a real service. It has no file upload and takes no payment.

description: Test form for checking S3 submission, collecting a single line of text. Not for public use, and it should not be deleted. It is separate from the similar test form named for Stephen, which tests S3 submission with a different form.
